'''Cooking:''' 40 minutes | Difficulty = 1 }}{{Recipe}} '''Risengrød''' is part of the Nordic Christmas tradition as a dinner dish. It is simply rice boiled with milk and a little sugar to form porridge, and it is served warm with butter and cinnamon-sugar.{{Cite web |title=Risengrød {{!}} Public Domain Recipes |url=https://publicdomainrecipes.com/risengroed/ |access-date=2024-12-09 |website=publicdomainrecipes.com}} ==Ingredients== *3 [[Cookbook:dl|dl]] (300 [[Cookbook:ML|ml]] / 1¼ [[Cookbook:cup|cups]]) [[Cookbook:water|water]] *180 [[Cookbook:g|g]] porridge [[Cookbook:rice|rice]] *1 [[Cookbook:liter|liter]] whole [[Cookbook:milk|milk]] *2 [[Cookbook:pinch|pinches]] [[Cookbook:salt|salt]] *4 [[Cookbook:tablespoon|tbsp]] white granulated [[Cookbook:sugar|sugar]] *2 [[Cookbook:teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:cinnamon|cinnamon]] *50 g [[Cookbook:butter|butter]] ==Equipment== *[[Cookbook:Stock Pot|Deep pot]] with lid *[[Cookbook:Mixing Bowl|Bowl]] *Mixing spoon or [[Cookbook:Spatula|spatula]] ==Procedure== # Bring water and rice to a [[Cookbook:boiling|boil]] in a deep pot. Boil the rice at steady heat and with active stirring for approximately 2 minutes. # Add milk and return to a boil. Simmer over low heat, stirring actively for approximately 10 minutes. # Put on lid and simmer for approximately 30 minutes, stirring often to prevent sticking. # Test the porridge for thickness—if it seems too thin, simmer for another 5–10 minutes. # Add salt. # Combine sugar and cinnamon in a bowl or container. # Serve porridge warm with cinnamon-sugar on top and a bit of butter in the middle. ==References== [[Category:Recipes using white sugar]] [[Category:Recipes using rice]] [[Category:Recipes using butter]] [[Category:Recipes using whole milk]] [[Category:Recipes for rice pudding]] [[Category:Danish recipes]] [[Category:Recipes using cinnamon]] [[Category:Christmas recipes]]
